remarks: Amazing home on a beautiful tree-lined street-Clarence Schools Many thoughtful updates thru-out. 4 spacious bedrooms/2.5 baths & a huge fully-fenced yard! The 2-story foyer is roomy w/ stunning hardwood & an attractive stairway to the 2nd floor. The family room to the left of the foyer has a coat closet and sliding doors to the rear patio. There is a mudroom/1/2 bath with 2 sinks off the family rm and a door to the 2.5 car garage. The living room has orignial hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace. The cathedral ceiling features skylights & new recessed lighting found thru-out most of the home. This room is open to the formal dining rm & both have walls of windows embracing the natural sunlight. The kitchen is updated with quartz countertops and there is a dining area for your casual meals. Step down to the back door entry & into the family room. At the top of the stairs is a flex room, 3 secondary bedrooms, a full bath w/jetted tub-shower and stackable washer & dryer. The Primary bedroom suite has a huge closet. This ensuite also has a walk-in jetted tub-shower & a walk-in dressing area w/ 2 add'l closets. The open loft area has a double sized linen closet for your convenience. Some updates incl: Interior & exterior painting, floor in family rm & flex rm 2026.. Kitchen remodel including new stovetop, quartz counters 2026, dishwasher 2024.. Bathrooms remodeled in 2017-2019 w/all new doors upstairs & mirrored closet doors. The first floor 1/2 bath is plumbed & has potential to be a 3rd full bath..bathroom countertops upstairs are quartz.. downstairs 1/2 bath is granite w/a vessel sink. Pool was filled-in 2026..Sump pumps & back-up sump pumps 2017-2019..Fiberglass roof within the last 5 years (Erie roofing), Brand new paint thru-out house 2025-2026..Brand new front door 2026..Basement has been freshly painted; floor and walls 2026..New basement stairs 2026..New boiler within the last 10 years..New electrical box added within the last 10 years..New vinyl privacy fence between 2017-2019..No stone left unturned..Welcome home to 4885 Smiley Terrace!
